conditions.note: Datasets were written by the project author; routing/tool labels were not used to tune rules after this run.

routing.method: Supervisor's top intent (full LangGraph run via API) compared with the labelled intent. Items marked memory=true first establish ORD-1002 in the same conversation.

failures.text: I want to send this back, is that possible?
Can I cancel an order after it ships?
I need a portable speaker for the beach
which smartwatch is good for running?

tool_selection.method: The set of tools actually executed during the turn (from the execution trace) must equal the labelled set.

failures.text: What's in ORD-1002 and how much was it?

task_completion.method: Scripted multi-turn scenarios (including admin approve/reject) checked against response content, citations, memory flags and resulting database rows.

retrieval.method: Fraction of the top-5 retrieved chunks whose policy section is labelled relevant. Each query has only 1-2 relevant sections, so the attainable ceiling is reported alongside the score.

groundedness.method: An answer sentence is 'supported' when >=80% of its content tokens appear in one cited chunk. In deterministic mode answers are extractive, so high support is expected by construction; the more informative numbers are relevant_citation_rate and abstention accuracy on unanswerable questions.
groundedness.llm_judge: Not Evaluated: LLM-as-judge groundedness requires an LLM API key, which was not configured for this run.

latency.method: Every POST /api/chat issued during this evaluation, measured in-process (FastAPI TestClient, no network hop). graph_ms = LangGraph execution; api_ms = full request including auth and persistence.
